note: YC S25 company (Founded 2025, San Francisco, team size 2; founders Tom Greenwald CEO and Anders Lie CTO), same magnitude.dev domain as the browser-agent card. The company has pivoted twice: originally launched on YC as 'Sidekick' (chat-driven automation, Zapier alternative), then became 'Magnitude' — an open-source browser-agent framework (magnitudedev/browser-agent, Apache-2.0) — and has now repositioned again as an open-source local/open-model inference engine for coding agents (Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, etc.), free and open source with 'No token costs, API keys, subscriptions, or rate limits.' No hosted browser/VM/sandbox product remains; the original browser-agent card's caveat about discontinuation is consistent with this. No independent funding round beyond YC's standard investment could be confirmed in the time budget; treat funding stage/amount as low-confidence/unknown.
